item.title: A transformative Deadlock update just hit its entire roster with 850 lines of patch notes. Here are the biggest changes.
item.description: Valve’s transformative new Deadlock patch notes include skill reworks, item overhauls, movement changes, and fresh neutral camps on the map.

item.title: Rust's new boats just got a lot more customizable, with longer days to build them
item.description: The Rust Shipshape update adds more ways to tweak and improve your boats, along with the introduction of longer days in the survival game.

item.title: The Riftbreaker's explosive blend of co-op base building and Diablo-style action is free to try right now
item.description: The Riftbreaker’s combination of base-building survival game and high-octane ARPG just got bigger, and a free weekend lets you try it now.

item.title: This VPN ban is edging ever closer, and here's what it means for your privacy
item.description: A new consultation, which will conclude in May 2026, will determine whether or not there is a VPN ban for people under 18 in the UK.

item.title: Granblue Fantasy Relink is the stylish-action gift that keeps on giving, and I can't wait for more
item.description: Upcoming Granblue Fantasy Relink expansion Endless Ragnarok is your ideal excuse to correct the mistake of skipping this stunning JRPG.

item.title: Why the Valheim devs casually spun up a new studio while working on 1.0
item.description: Why did these Valheim devs casually spin up a new studio while working on 1.0? “Because it’s fun.”

item.title: Slay the Spire 2 dev Mega Crit is "totally blown away" by its half-million player peak, but it's another indie triumph
item.description: The massive Slay the Spire 2 Steam peak has Mega Crit founder Casey Yano feeling bad about a Marathon joke, but it’s a true second coming.

item.title: The Overwatch devs think you're banning the wrong heroes
item.description: Blizzard reveals the current Overwatch ban rates and win percentages for its five new heroes, and Mizuki is slipping under the radar.

item.title: Marvel Rivals launches new "anti-throwing" tech with compensation for victims
item.description: The new Marvel Rivals anti-throwing measures are being implemented to counter deliberate sabotage, and lost ranked points will be returned.

item.title: Become a sentient AI in one of the most laser-focused strategy games I've ever played, Heart of the Machine
item.description: Heart of the Machine 1.0 is out now, blending pieces from the likes of Civilization, Cities Skylines, and XCOM into a unique strategy game.
